# Locally served browser dependencies

Copied from the corresponding npm packages, with original copyright/license notices retained:

- GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.12.2 — original existing site versions, copyright and licensing URL retained in file headers. Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.12.2

Tailwind CSS 3.4.17 is used only to produce `../utilities.css`. It is not a browser dependency. See the project README for rebuilding.

The archived Journal and its Markdown/sanitizer libraries can be recovered from Git tag `review-before-journal-archive`.
